{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.70

|gr1= Sensors

|descr= Sets the AI rule of Radar usage (Emission Control). Automatic means Radar switched on only when in Combat. The command doesn't affect player-controlled vehicles.

|s1= vehicle [[setVehicleRadar]] rule

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - an AI-controlled vehicle

|p2= rule: [[Number]] - can be one of the following:
* 0 - automatic
* 1 - forced on
* 2 - forced off

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_vehicle setVehicleRadar 1;</sqf>

|seealso= [[isVehicleRadarOn]] [[vehicleReportRemoteTargets]] [[setVehicleReportRemoteTargets]] [[vehicleReceiveRemoteTargets]] [[setVehicleReceiveRemoteTargets]] [[vehicleReportOwnPosition]] [[setVehicleReportOwnPosition]] [[reportRemoteTarget]] [[confirmSensorTarget]]
}}
